parsedOutput.description: A comforting blend of tart mixed berries tucked under a golden, crunchy oat topping. It is the perfect warm treat for a cozy evening or a weekend brunch.

instructions.body: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly grease a large baking dish.
Spread the frozen mixed berries evenly across the bottom of the prepared dish.
In a medium bowl, mix the oats, flour, brown sugar, and cinnamon together.
Cut the cold butter into the oat mixture using a pastry cutter or fork until it looks like coarse crumbs.
Sprinkle the oat topping evenly over the berries.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the fruit is bubbling and the topping is golden brown.

parsedOutput.story: This crumble is our go-to whenever we need something sweet but effortless. It turns a bag of frozen fruit into a centerpiece that brings everyone to the kitchen table.
parsedOutput.title: Simple Berry Oat Crumble
